The jobs that prepare pictures run here: GitHub Actions. This page refreshes itself while a picture is being prepared. Signing in lasts four hours in this tab.

No install. The combined view is a short video encrypted with Common Encryption; the browser's own DRM decrypts it inside the device's protected path (Widevine in Chrome and Edge, PlayReady as a fallback in Edge on Windows, FairPlay on Apple devices). The combined view is shown only with protection this page accepts: hardware protection (Widevine or PlayReady) on any device; and software protection in Chrome and Edge on Windows and in Chrome on Android (screenshots under it were measured black in Chrome and Edge on a Windows PC and in Chrome on an Android phone, 2026-10-11) and, not yet measured, in Edge on Android and in the other browsers on Windows and Android that this page reads as Chrome (apps' built-in browsers, DuckDuckGo, Yandex, Vivaldi and others). Software protection anywhere else is not accepted, Samsung Internet, Opera and Firefox included: a screenshot on a test machine showed the test card in Firefox on a Mac and in Chrome on Linux; other browsers and platforms are not yet measured on a real device. On an iPhone or iPad it is shown only through Apple's FairPlay (screenshots of FairPlay video were measured black on an iPhone, 2026-10-12, both of Apple's test videos and of one of the test site's pictures, licensed by our own Axinom account as they all are; a screen recording, an iPad and other iOS versions are not yet measured); on a Mac it is held back until a screenshot there is measured black. It starts on its own when the page opens; the buttons only run it again.

Apple's test, on this iPhone, iPad or Mac. Your pictures are held back here until a screenshot on this kind of device is measured black. Instead, the four short videos above play, none of them a CCS picture: three through Apple's protected path (FairPlay), namely Axinom's test film, our test card, and our test card licensed by our own Axinom account as a picture would be; and the film unprotected, as a control.

  1. Wait until the videos are moving (about ten seconds; one that cannot play says why under it), and scroll so that all four videos and the line under each are on the screen.
  2. Take a screenshot (press the side or top button together with volume up, or with the Home button on a model that has one; on a Mac, Shift-Command-3), and a screen recording if you can.
  3. Open the screenshot in Photos. The protected ones should be black; the control should show the film. A black one counts only if the line under it says playing with a size (for example 720x960) and its time moving; if it says no frame, nothing was playing there, and if the control is black too, the screenshot proves nothing on this device.

Apple's test, what happened, in order


  
The film is Tears of Steel by the Blender Foundation (CC BY 3.0), from Axinom's public test streams. The protected videos are licensed by Axinom's FairPlay licence service with Axinom's evaluation FairPlay certificate, issued by Apple: the film under Axinom's own packaging, the card under ours (tools/fairplay-card.mjs). The card's first form uses Axinom's public test key, which Axinom's public licence token unlocks; its second uses a key of its own, whose token our account made.
